newsitem.title: USA: Tyco CEO comfortable with FY 97 estimates.
newsitem.headline: Tyco CEO comfortable with FY 97 estimates.

text.p: Tyco International Ltd Chief Executive and Chairman Dennis Kozlowski said he was comfortable with analysts' consensus earnings estimates of $2.52 per share for the fiscal year 1997.
He was speaking to Reuters after a presentation at the Smith Barney Multi-Industry Conference in New York City.
He told the conference that he sees sales of around $6.5 billion for the fiscal year ending June 30, 1997.
"This year we'll be around $6.5 billion," he said.
Tyco earned $1.12 per share in the first half of fiscal 1997 on sales of $3.1 billion.

During the presentation he told analysts that the company would continue its acquisition-led growth strategy and was looking at around 40 deals at any given time. He said the company expected to announce some acquisitions in the next three to six months, but declined to name them.
